name: gate
description: Create a resource-scoped event and local unlock controller. Local unlock state is a UI convenience; enforce paid access on the server.

name: content
description: Emit content_registered with normalized resource metadata. Returns true only when the browser hub receives it immediately; false may mean queued or no browser.

name: registerContent
description: Alias behavior for content: emits content_registered. This event does not itself publish content or verify domain ownership.

name: view
description: Emit resource_view. Supply extra context such as source; normalization attaches the resource.

name: track
description: Emit a custom event and payload. Resource defaults are not automatically attached to this method.

name: unlockStarted
description: Emit unlock_started; this is telemetry and does not initiate payment.

name: unlockCompleted
description: Emit unlock_completed after your verified flow. The client method only emits; gate.unlockCompleted also marks local state.

name: paymentCompleted
description: Emit payment_completed after verification. This method reports a payment; it does not transfer funds or verify a receipt.

name: rateResource
description: Normalize a rating and emit content_rating. Returns a boolean, not a Promise, and does not send an onchain transaction.

name: trackResourcePage
description: Validate metadata, emit content and view events, and return a gate. Browser metadata warnings are enabled unless the implementation-only warn option is false.

name: checkResourceAccess
description: Fetch the access route (default /api/nibgate/access). A 402 returns a challenge unless checkout or autoPay is configured. Network errors reject; inspect result.ok before using protected payload.
example:
const result = await client.checkResourceAccess(resource, { accessPath: "/api/nibgate/access?id=article-1" });
if (result.ok) console.log(result.payload);

name: payWithPaymentSignature
description: Submit a supplied payment signature or invoke checkout/createPaymentSignature, then verify through the access route. Supply one of these: omitting all causes a callback error. Stores unlock proof on verified success.
example: const result = await client.payWithPaymentSignature(resource, { paymentSignature: verifiedPaymentSignature, accessPath: "/api/nibgate/access?id=article-1" });

name: createWalletCheckout
description: Create an unlock controller around a required checkout/createPaymentSignature/pay callback. mount binds the button; unlock checks access and invokes checkout only after a challenge.
example:
const checkout = client.createWalletCheckout(resource, { checkout: walletCheckout, button: "#unlock" });
checkout.mount();

name: createCircleGatewayBrowserAdapter
description: Lazily import the Gateway adapter. Supply signer or getSigner; the adapter signs typed data when pay is invoked. No payment is performed merely by creating it.

name: createTransferCheckout
description: Require sendTransfer (or transfer), then return a pay callback that converts its transaction hash into verification metadata. A server verifyTransfer hook must verify the real transfer. The exported TypeScript declaration references missing transfer types in v0.4.40.

name: payWithTransfer
description: Invoke a transfer checkout, obtain its transaction hash, optionally sign ownership, and call the access verifier. Hosted verification needs ownership proof; a public hash alone is insufficient. Transfer option/result type declarations are missing in v0.4.40.
example: const result = await client.payWithTransfer(resource, { sendTransfer, signOwnership, accessPath: "/api/nibgate/access?id=article-1" });

name: createEvmGatewayUnlock
description: Create the Arc Gateway UI controller. Select the intended network explicitly (default is Arc Testnet). autoMount defaults true. Retain unresolved proofs and use retryVerification instead of authorizing another payment; destroy removes listeners.

name: createHostedUnlock
description: Wrap createEvmGatewayUnlock with hosted: true. The selected network chooses api.nibgate.xyz/hub/pay or testnet-api.nibgate.xyz/hub/pay; an explicit non-hosted accessPath still takes precedence.
example:
const controller = client.createHostedUnlock(resource, { network: "eip155:5042002", provider, autoMount: false });
controller.destroy();

name: rateContentOnchain
description: Request an EVM account, prepare the content hash, switch to Arc, and send a rating transaction. Returns a submitted txHash, not a finality guarantee; emits onchain_pending telemetry. Requires a valid rating and configured contract/provider.
example: const submitted = await client.rateContentOnchain(resource, { provider, rating: 4, unlockRef: "verified-receipt-id" });

name: createOnchainRating
description: Bind rating controls to the onchain flow. autoMount defaults true. Supply payment or getUnlockRef so ratings can reference a verified unlock; rate can request a wallet transaction.
example:
const rating = client.createOnchainRating(resource, { provider, autoMount: false, payment: { paymentId: "verified-receipt-id" } });
rating.setVisible(true);

name: mountRatingUI
description: Mount a five-star telemetry UI, or return null without a browser/target. Known v0.4.40 bug: star click invokes .catch on the boolean returned by rateResource. Controller rate signature also differs from its declaration; prefer rateResource until fixed.

name: payAndUnlockResource
description: POST resource and optional payPayload to payPath (default /api/nibgate/pay). Requires both HTTP success and payload.ok, stores proof, and marks the local gate unlocked. The server owns payment verification.
example:
const result = await client.payAndUnlockResource(resource, { payPath: "/api/nibgate/pay" });
if (result.ok) console.log(result.payment);

name: setupResourcePage
description: Track the page and optionally bind a button to checkResourceAccess. The browser handler disables the button while awaiting access; it does not render the protected payload for you.
example: const page = client.setupResourcePage(resource, { button: "#unlock", status: "#status", accessPath: "/api/nibgate/access?id=article-1" });

name: ratingMessage
description: Produce the canonical rating message with normalized resource defaults. This is text to sign, not a signature or onchain submission.

name: normalizeResource
description: Merge client resource defaults and normalize identity, type, price, access, unlock and discovery fields. In a browser, missing metadata may derive from document tags. This is normalization, not authorization.
example: const normalized = client.normalizeResource({ id: "article-1", type: "doc", price: "1" });

name: normalizeContentType
description: Map aliases such as audio to music and pdf to document. Unknown or empty input falls back to article.

name: flush
description: Drain queued events only when the browser hub track function is available. Returns true when at least one queued event was forwarded; false otherwise.

name: validateResourceMetadata
description: Standalone export only at runtime in v0.4.40. The NibgateClient declaration incorrectly lists it as a method. Returns normalized resource, score, errors, warnings and ok; use this standalone import.
